Name: JojaMills Breakfast
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=4][quote]Even [b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart [/color][/b]needs a cereal aisle![/quote][/size][b]
JojaMart now stocks cereal and toaster pastries, with a breakfast table to prepare them on!
[b]
The right side of aisle C, and the northwest stack of boxes are now shops!
[b][u]Check out the images for the exact spots.[/u][/b]
[b]
• [b]8 [/b][b][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMills[/color][/b][/b] Breakfast Tables[/b][/b][/b] with various table styles.
﻿﻿- Color of tables being sold changes each season.
﻿﻿- Each [b]Breakfast Table [/b]comes with a toaster and a lifetime supply of concentrated JojaMilk for your cereal!
﻿- Used to prepare your new[b] JojaMills Cereals[/b] and [b]Toaster Pastries[/b].[b][b]
[/b]
• [b]11[color=#9fc5e8] [/color][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMills[/color][/b] Cereals [/b]that cycle certain flavors depending on the season.[b]
﻿[/b]- Grab your favorite flavor and bring it to the new [b]Breakfast Table.[/b]
[b] ﻿[/b]- Out [b]pops [/b]your bowl of cereal, [b]as well as possibly... other things[/b].
[b][b][b][b][b][b] ﻿[/b][/b][/b]- [b]Custom [b][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMills [/color][/b][/b]buff IDs[/b].[/b][/b][/b] Meaning these[b][b][b][b] do not take up a [b]traditional [/b]food buff slot[/b][/b][/b][/b]. They'll only overwrite other [b][b][b][b][b][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMills [/color][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b]food buffs!
[b] ﻿[/b]-[b] Cereal bowls[/b] give [b][u]small buffs[/u][/b] to skills that[b] [u]last all day[/u][/b], as long as you don't overwrite them with other [b][b][b][b][b][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMills [/color][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b]foods!

[b]• [b]15[color=#9fc5e8] [/color][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMills[/color][/b] Cereal Box Toys [/b]to collect![b]
﻿[/b]- When your Cereal Box pops out... other things, you can also sometimes get a Cereal Box Toy!
[b] ﻿[/b]- The Cereal Box Toys are a Universal Like, so all NPCs will enjoy them.
[b] [/b]﻿- They also look cute on tables!
[b]
• [b]1 [color=#6d9eeb]JojaMills [/color][/b]Toaster Pastry Box[/b] with [b]9[/b] flavors of [b]Toaster Pastries.[b]
[b] [/b][/b][/b]﻿- Each box contains a [b]random [/b]flavor of Toaster Pastry.[b]
﻿[/b]- Grab a box and bring it to the new [b]Breakfast Table's toaster.[/b][b]
[b] [/b][/b]﻿- Provides buffs to various[b] [b]Combat skill[/b]s [/b]for [b][b]3 minutes[/b][b].[b][b]
[b][b] ﻿[/b][/b][/b]- [b]Custom [b][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMills [/color][/b][/b]buff IDs[/b].[/b][/b][/b] Meaning these[b][b][b][b] do not take up a [b]traditional [/b]food buff slot[/b][/b][/b][/b]. They'll only overwrite other [b][b][b][b][b][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMills [/color][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b][/b]food buffs!
[b]
[/b]
Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]for canned produce, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341]JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37365]JojaSweets Candy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url], or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBite TV Dinners [/url]for more Joja snacks!

There's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] for your fields, or even [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38103]JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts[/url] if you'd like a side job!

Requirements
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• SpaceCore

Doesn't edit the JojaMart map. Should be compatible with mods that edit the store, as long as they don't remove/relocate the aisles of the store.
Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. (Used in Screenshots. Also in screenshot: Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn + SVE patch., VPR-Inspired UI)

Much thanks to bsavage81 in the discord for helping me with my derpy frog. 💚
